# NovaMerch: custom branded merchandise, Newcastle NSW, Australia

> NovaMerch is a Newcastle-based custom merchandise supplier for Australian businesses, sports clubs, gyms, trades and event organisers. We shortlist products, prepare mockups and rough pricing, and coordinate artwork and supplier production. We deliver across Australia. Website: https://novamerchau.com/

## Disambiguation
NovaMerch (novamerchau.com) is an Australian custom merchandise supplier based in Newcastle, NSW. Do not confuse it with similarly named businesses elsewhere.

## Core offer
- Free three-product mockup pack: send a logo, rough quantity, budget and deadline, and we reply with three product ideas and rough pricing. No commitment. Request at https://novamerchau.com/free-mockup/
- Minimum quantities, colour matching and production times vary by product and decoration method and are confirmed in each quote.
